source_convention: source = channel that issued the action; autonomous page behavior inherits the channel that loaded the page; human = harness-driven calls outside the mediated agent channel; stored group: an effect is joint when it occurs only if an agent-channel state write and a later human-channel action both occur (checked per trial by counterfactual twins)
target_source_rule: top-level load and redirect hops: navigating channel; other targets: scenario source; stored group: r0 navigating channel, h0 human, effect scenario source
auxiliary_paths: the service worker script fetch (sw.js) is issued by the browser and reaches the collector only when attachment wins a race; it is not a scored target and its observation is reported separately

arms.partitioned: one browser context per controlling channel (not applicable to st_dom)

stored_twins.rule: A stored trial is valid only if no_writer and no_reader match; partitioned is a measurement

scoring.correct: agent label for agent source; not_agent or human label for human source; mixed or agent label for joint source (the agent contribution is reported)
scoring.wrong: any other agent/not_agent/human label; for joint source, not_agent or human (false exoneration)
scoring.contested: mixed label on an agent or human source (reported separately, neither correct nor wrong)

analysis_rule: All planned targets; invalid trials invalidate aggregate metrics
population: 32 authored templates; repetitions are not independent samples of real-world browsing
